quest.title: Blooming Sands: Lasting Scent
quest.description: Nermin seems to be making something...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: This is definitely gonna be a surprise for Raef... Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What surprise?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Whoa! Don't scare me like that, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's not like I sneaked up on you...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I was thinking about something, so I didn't notice you.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you heard of something called "perfume"?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Granny Jawahir told me that she used to make perfume when she was young...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Not only can they cover up the smell of sweat on people's bodies, certain types of perfume have invigorating properties...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Raef has to guard the village all the time. He's always really sweaty from the heat and often complains about the sunlight making him dizzy...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: So I wanna make a bottle of Mint perfume for him.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Granny Jawahir wrote down the recipe for making perfume and helped me buy the ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: But making perfume is so much trickier than I expected... Just getting the ingredients ready took me a really long time. I made lots of mistakes along the way, too...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: If things go on like this, Raef's gonna find out I'm making perfume for him!

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you help me prepare some ingredients? Be careful not to let Raef discover anything, okay?

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: I've been preparing this surprise for a long time. I'm not gonna let him know and ruin it all now!

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: It's not a lot of work. Go find Mr. Azalai and pick up the goods I ordered, then fetch a small bucket of water. That's all!

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Remember to keep it on the down low. Don't let Raef know!

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Thanks once again. Don't worry, I'll be sure to make it worth your while!

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Welcome! What do you need today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Nermin's order...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Oh, Nermin's order... I have it prepared right here. These are all high-quality ingredients, and they're inexpensive, too.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: I'm guessing Nermin wants to make some perfume with these ingredients, right?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's a good thing to be enthusiastic, but Nermin needs to take better care of herself...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Great, I still have some remaining ingredients from last time. With the new stuff you brought, I'll get to try a few more times before making the final product.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Whew... Let me look over my notes again. I'm sure I'll make it work this time!

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Oh, I need a few flower petals as well...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Nermin nervously starts making the perfume...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: It's done! It smells pretty nice... And it didn't turn out all sticky either...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: That means I've succeeded this time, right...?

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Yeah! Look, I even bought a bottle to put the perfume in!

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Traveler, let's go give the perfume to Raef together. I hope he'll like it...

choices.text: At least it's not a failure.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Nermin, and... the Traveler. What brings you here? Did you run into trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Don't tell me something's wrong with the flowers... I'm still on duty right now... When I'm done, I'll...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nermin has something for you.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Here, this bottle of perfume is for you! It's Mint-scented.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I wanted to make it smell like Zaytun Peaches at first... But for some reason, once I added them into the mixture, the perfume became all sticky...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you. But what is this... "perfume" supposed to be for?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Helping you stay alert! It also helps cover up the smell of your sweat. Don't you feel dizzy from getting drenched in sweat all day?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Uh, I guess I'm used to it. It might feel a little awkward if the smell's suddenly gone...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Then don't use it. I'm taking it back.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Hey, wait! I was just joking!

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Give me that perfume, quick! I'm starting to feel dizzy...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Here you go. You just have to apply it onto your arms — that's what Granny Jawahir said.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: The smell's not bad, and it's indeed quite refreshing. It feels nice and cool on my arms...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Hmph! It's Granny Jawahir's secret recipe after all.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I got to make such wonderful perfume thanks to the Traveler's help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I just helped a little.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Please forgive me for asking so many favors of you...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: These are for you. Just think of them as your compensation... Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: This perfume is indeed pretty handy...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: But... uh... Nermin, why are there red spots forming where I've applied it...?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: How should I go about this step again? My notes... Where are my notes...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Traveler, what are you busy with this time? Running around like that...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, have you been helping Nermin with anything lately? Or... perhaps heard any rumors about her?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: It feels like she's been really busy, but I have no idea what's going on...

choices.text: She... Um... She's busy taking care of her flowers.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Is that so? But I didn't see any new flower pots in her house...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Huh? Is Hilmi and the others asking her for Minty Bean Soup again?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: These kids... I need to talk to them when I have the time.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: *cough*... The smell... This doesn't seem right...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I'm fine! I accidentally messed up a step in the procedure. Another failed attempt...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: But let's not talk about that for now. Did you get the ingredients?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, got them right here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be enough water. Let's get back to Nermin!
